stages.headline: If the distance d from the centre to the line is less than r, the line cuts the circle in two points — a secant.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the distance d from the centre to the line is less than r, the line cuts the circle in two points — a secant.

stages.headline: If d = r the line touches the circle at one point (a tangent); if d > r they have no common point.
stages.headlineEnglish: If d = r the line touches the circle at one point (a tangent); if d > r they have no common point.
